title: Unit 13 Consolidation: Monetary Sovereignty, the Forint & the Eurozone Dilemma
goal: I can recount the history of the forint from the hyperinflation of 1946 to the Bokros Package of 1995.
I can explain speculative attacks and the move to a floating exchange rate.
I can describe the foreign currency loan crisis and the arguments about adopting the euro.
